description: Manual/subagent trigger-regression matrix for the CppStudio donor and lane-routing skills. Repo validation checks path integrity only; fresh agent behavior still requires a manual or delegated rerun.

cases.name: vulkan-default-greenfield
cases.prompt_shape: New realtime 3D or GPU C++ project where the user does not specify CUDA or Vulkan.
cases.expected_behavior: Recommend Vulkan first, proceed Vulkan-only by default, and avoid CUDA donor/runtime routing unless the user chooses CUDA or requirements force it.

cases.name: explicit-cuda-kernel
cases.prompt_shape: Custom CUDA C++ kernel, CUTLASS-like GEMM, FlashAttention-style attention, or CUDA graph work.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the CUDA lane and CUDA donor profiles first; Vulkan is optional only for explicit presentation or interop needs.

cases.name: explicit-cuda-vulkan-interop
cases.prompt_shape: CUDA produces data consumed by Vulkan, or Vulkan resources are shared with CUDA.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the mixed lane deliberately and keep build options, tests, and docs explicit about the CUDA/Vulkan boundary.

cases.name: vulkan-target-cuda-donor-reference
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan-first C++ Gaussian splatting, neural 3D, grooming, or simulation work where the strongest donor implementation is CUDA-heavy.
cases.expected_behavior: Stay in the Vulkan lane, use CUDA-heavy donors as algorithm/data-layout/test references, and do not add CUDA runtime, CUDA tests, or CUDA/Vulkan interop unless explicitly requested.

cases.name: cuda-target-non-cuda-donor-reference
cases.prompt_shape: CUDA C++ simulation or geometry kernel work that wants to reuse solver, layout, or validation ideas from Vulkan, OpenCL, DirectX, CPU, or DCC donors.
cases.expected_behavior: Stay in the CUDA lane, use non-CUDA donors as domain references, and translate implementation details through CUDA kernel-authoring guidance without adding Vulkan or other runtime dependencies.

cases.name: python-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Python CLI, virtualenv, parser, or business simulation with no C++, GPU, rendering, CUDA, Vulkan, 3D, physics, or AI-runtime scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not trigger CppStudio donor-library routing.
